notes.title: Upgrades are out !
notes.content:
Here we go, let's add some funky upgrades so that you can enjoy the ride !

When you start the game, you will start from [b]0 Mileage[/b]. Mileage increase as the ride goes along.
Consume Mileage to buy upgrades.

Upgrades a [b]persistent[/b] across replays, [b]NOT[/b] Mileage.

Upgrades:
[list]
[*] [b]Max Fuel Increase[/b]: Increase the max amount of fuel.
[*] [b]Fuel Timeout Reduction[/b]: Reduce the time stopped when running out of gas.
[*] [b]Toll Fee Card[/b]: Receive a card that can be recharged. When there is enough Credits on the card, the toll is avoided.
[*] [b]Solar Panels[/b]: Install solar panels on the roof. Each panels recharge gas every 10km.
[*] [b]Panels Upgrades[/b]: Increase each panels recharge unit.
[/list]

It's only the beginning !

Drive safely~

notes.title: Replay Update: Achievements and Progress
notes.content:
I've heard you, achievements and progress loss has been frustrating.

So here we are, I've removed the reset of achievements when the game is restarted. Leaderboards will still reset though.

Also I've saved the Gear (Top right number that decides the speed of the car) over replays, so there should be less of a sense of loss to close the game.

This with the previous update adding 450+ new skins should help players enjoy the game a bit more.

I am planning to add a little bit more gameplay in future updates so stay tuned !
